# Fixture for PERF-PY-28 (vulnerable)
lang: python
file: app/parallel.py
---
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import zlib

def compress_chunks(chunks):
    def task(index):
        return zlib.compress(chunks[index])

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as executor:
        return list(executor.map(task, range(len(chunks))))

def handle_request(payloads):
    return compress_chunks(payloads)
